title: Pair Connectors
written_solution: Each non-background color appears exactly twice. If the two copies lie in the same row, fill the horizontal segment between them; if they lie in the same column, fill the vertical segment between them. Keep the endpoints themselves.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([color (in-list (remove-duplicates
                                         (map third
                                           (filter (lambda (cell) (not (= (third cell) 0)))
                                                   (grid-cells g)))))])
    (let ((pts (find-color g color)))
      (if (= (length pts) 2)
          (let ((a (first pts)) (b (second pts)))
            (cond [(= (first a) (first b))
                   (paint-cells out
                     (for/list ([c (in-range (min (second a) (second b))
                                             (+ (max (second a) (second b)) 1))])
                       (list (first a) c))
                     color)]
                  [(= (second a) (second b))
                   (paint-cells out
                     (for/list ([r (in-range (min (first a) (first b))
                                             (+ (max (first a) (first b)) 1))])
                       (list r (second a)))
                     color)]
                  [else out]))
          out))))
